text: You have a girlfriend and she hides from you that she reads Korean comics with adult content. What to do? Hey man, I don't know what my next step should be on this situation and I don't know what to do. I'm sorry if this is long. Well, better long than short, right? Is it okay if you don't post it, though? Feel free to respond. Sorry man, I suppose you watched my other videos before sending your story, so you should know that I rarely answer DMs. Normally, I either break it down directly on a channel or leave it unanswered. I am having trust issues with my girlfriend, even though she did a pinky promise to me about it. Pinky promise? Damn man, I guess we have a story from a young guy. Well, later he says they are teenagers in high school, so I suppose 16 to 18 years old. I normally try not to feature teenager stories on the channel, but this one sounded quite interesting. My guts and what I've seen from her proof and reasoning is really lacking, which makes me feel bad about myself about trust issues. I was in my girlfriend's room waiting for her to finish showering. I was on her TikTok. We can let each other on our phones. We agreed to it. I've seen an interesting video, and it made me curious to search on Google. I stumbled across a website named Inkora. It had manhwa. I don't know what that means. I checked it. For those wondering, manhwa is Korean comic, sort of like Japanese manga, and got curious about that a lot because it seemed to be everywhere on her history. And so I clicked on one of them and seen a naked girl getting banged by a guy in some drawing comic romance thing. I scrolled to see what this was, and it looked just like Webtoon. She uses Webtoon too. And for those wondering what is Webtoon, it is a digital comic designed specifically to be read on a phone by scrolling vertically. The format started in South Korea and became extremely popular worldwide. I once saw a title that had 18+, but I didn't think Webtoon had those stuff. Anyways, I see a whole page of that and closes it off, trying to process what I saw and began thinking if other pages are like that. Most of them had those adult content. She is a fan of romance stories. And we're still teenagers in high school. We've been together over a year, and I'm just now realizing she reads those stuff. She got out of the bathroom and notices me with my phone, and she began getting defensive, and we were talking back and forth. My girlfriend gave me the phone. I want to watch TikTok. Me. You can grab my phone and see. We can see together. And she was still trying to snatch it. She then threatened to look through my phone, and I told her, go ahead, because I have nothing to hide. She tried making me give her phone, and after that didn't work, she got on me trying to get it. She said, give it to me. You're being a meanie in a jokingly voice, and I did. Long story short, we talked. She says it just redirects her on pages and weird websites, but from when I was on it, none of that showed up. I then tried it on my phone, and not a single redirect showed me to a weird story or a weird website. Her excuse was, I don't know how to explain it. It pops up a lot of times. I don't read that. I know this is personal, but I'm her boyfriend. It feels such a lie. I noticed she was on a specific chapter on that story, meaning she has been reading it. I went on my phone and did the test she was talking about, and every excuse didn't show. She pinky promised me that she's telling the truth, but my guts are telling me the opposite, because nothing matched. I also realized the website remembers where you left off, because that happened to me when I was looking at the description, which made me not trust her more. By the way, I felt numb the whole time. I didn't know how to react, and it was hard to show my emotions. I now don't know what to do. I just don't like the way it feels like a lie, even though she did a pinky promise. I didn't like the way she acted either. Okay, if I understood correctly, your issue is that your girlfriend may be reading Korean comics with some adult content. Is that right? Now, I'm a bit of an older guy myself, so I don't know much about those Korean comics, but let me tell you this. Women do like to read romance stories, especially with some adult stuff in it. There's a reason why Fifty Shades of Grey is one of the most popular books ever written. If that is the only issue in your relationship, everything else is fine, then I don't think that's such a big of a problem. Now, I still think it would be good to talk to her if that really bothers you. As an example, you can say that it is fine if she sometimes reads stuff like that, because, for example, I suppose you watch porn, right? But you would like there to be no secrets, to be open about it, and so on. What I'm trying to say is, to me, it seems like this is not such a big issue and it can be resolved by talking to your partner. If after that the issue still persists or it still bothers you a lot, well, fair enough, you tried, it didn't work, you can end the relationship. If you watch my videos, you probably know that I anyways do not recommend young guys to go into relationships too early. But here I just work with your situation. Again, sounds to me like not a big issue. Talk straight, say what bothers you, be open with each other, and hopefully you can resolve this issue.
